comment: Exact-fingerprint ledger of candidate divergences found by the F1a harness and recorded, not fixed, in docs/recompiler-core-audit-2026-09-13/infrastructure/DIFFTEST_F1A.md. Applied only for this seed/scale. Every run prints each entry as KNOWN; any change to a group (new vector, different value) or a group that stops reproducing fails ctest. Deleting this file makes ctest difftest_f1a fail on these candidates. Regenerated 2026-10-06 (native time): the same 7 candidates over the same vectors. The 5 DT-F1A-C2 fingerprints changed because native lanes have no instruction count (the 'generated' value of the retired field is null) and, for lmw ls1-00350, because TB/DEC no longer advance per retired instruction in either the spec or the engines (the dec/tb fields no longer differ). Regenerated 2026-10-06 (M1, docs/memory-architecture-20261006): the same 7 candidates over the same vectors; the 5 DT-F1A-C2 fingerprints changed only because the harness names data-window bytes by their window address (0x803xxxxx) where it named them by the physical alias (0x003xxxxx) - scratch/memory-20261006/scripts/verify_f1a_ledger_m1.py maps the window addresses back and reproduces every old fingerprint exactly.
